forecast.vintage: policyengine-uk 2.174.1 ships the native October 2026 economic assumptions, including its documented derived and carried series; both policy sides use that same native path

policy.notes: An explicit dated rollback removes all tracked Autumn Budget 2026 policy changes before data loading. Selecting a measure restores only its native current-law parameter timeline. Unselected measures remain at pre-Budget policy.

calibration.source: the certified Microcosm UK dataset pinned by policyengine 6.17.2
calibration.vintage: as pinned by the installed bundle; the receipt records its exact identity

notes: policyengine-uk 2.174.1 ships the native October 2026 economic assumptions. Baseline and reform share those assumptions without a dashboard growth-rate override. The former obr_october_2026.json overlay remains archived for attribution of old published estimates and is not applied to new simulations. The actual pre-Budget policy rollback is separate from the forecast and from the certified dataset. Changes from model, data, forecast and policy-reference adoption must be reconciled separately; adopting this basis does not certify unchanged old published estimates.
